description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Register' within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles the email notification logic upon customer registration, including sending welcome emails and alerts to admin. The class contains methods to generate email content and initiate email sending via scheduled tasks.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling email notifications related to customer registration, including welcome emails and admin alerts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main registration email process, sending a welcome email to the new customer and scheduling the email task.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends an alert to administrators about a new customer registration, including customer details, and supports multiple alert email recipients.
